channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Derrick Favors | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Derrick Favors from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Wendell Carter on Derrick Favors
item.description:
“Just his determination, his attention to detail, inspired me. And then I got to get on the court a couple times with Derrick Favors up in Atlanta. His touch around the rim is still elite. Yeah, those two guys.”

Wendell Carter on Derrick Favors, Oct 13, 2026. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: Sam Presti on Derrick Favors
item.description:
Sam Presti on Derrick Favors:

“He brings defense and physicality. I'm excited to see how he fits. We'll have to see how the season unfolds. But I think he can help the team absolutely. We're excited about having him.”

Sam Presti on Derrick Favors, Sep 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mike Conley on Derrick Favors
item.description:
Ben Anderson:Mike Conley on Derrick Favors:

“Everybody loves Fav. He was talked about more than almost anybody when I first arrived here,even when he was in New Orleans.”

Mike Conley on Derrick Favors, Dec 4, 2020. Source: Twitter @BensHoops.

item.title: Rudy Gobert on Derrick Favors
item.description:
Eric Walden:Rudy Gobert, on the inability to go big-big last season:

“We could feel that sometimes, we lacked a little bit of size. Derrick is a very good defender.… We felt the drop, and we missed his presence. Having Derrick Favors back is fixing a lot of problems.”

Rudy Gobert on Derrick Favors, Dec 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Gail Miller on Derrick Favors
item.description:
Utah Jazz owner Gail Miller’s statement on Derrick Favors:

“Thank you Derrick for all you have done to elevate our team, bring excitement to our fans, show young people what character is, and for putting your imprint on our legacy. Your time in Utah will not be forgotten.”

Gail Miller on Derrick Favors, Jul 7, 2019. Source: Twitter @E_Woodyard.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Derrick Favors, Ekpe Udoh, DeSagana Diop
item.description:
“I think DeSagana’s done that with (Derrick Favors) and (Ekpe Udoh) and we wanted Raul to be a part of the groupand not only for Ricky, because obviously the relationship’s there, but to have an opportunity to work with our guys in the context of the coaching staff.”

Quin Snyder on Derrick Favors, Ekpe Udoh, DeSagana Diop, Sep 25, 2018. Source: Deseret News.

item.title: Dennis Lindsey on Derrick Favors
item.description:
“I think he understands what he has here and we certainly understand what he produces. His agent is a terrific person and that’s been able to carve out good deals for both sides, so I don’t see any initial obstacles. Derrick’s got to go through this process, but that’s my hope (he’ll be back).”

Dennis Lindsey on Derrick Favors, May 24, 2018. Source: Deseret News.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Derrick Favors
item.description:
Aaron Falk:Quin Snyder on Derrick Favors:

“Anybody that’s had back trouble, it’s tricky. Every situation is a little different and it's hard to know exactly.”

Quin Snyder on Derrick Favors, Jan 4, 2016. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Gordon Hayward on Derrick Favors, Rudy Gobert
item.description:
Jody Genessy:Gordon Hayward on the Favors-Gobert-Hayward trio:

“I don't know if we necessarily have a Big Three, but we are definitely three key pieces.”

Gordon Hayward on Derrick Favors, Rudy Gobert, Sep 28, 2015. Source: Twitter @DJJazzyJody.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Derrick Favors, Gordon Hayward
item.description:
Jazz coach Quin Snyder said.

“I thought Gordon was also terrific. Derrick’s line obviously stands out at you, but Gordon was almost as good. Those two guys - from a leadership standpoint - they just connected tonight.”

Quin Snyder on Derrick Favors, Gordon Hayward, Nov 2, 2014. Source: Salt Lake Tribune.

item.title: Al Jefferson on Derrick Favors
item.description:
Jefferson, now the Charlotte Bobcats’ starting center, believes it was the right decision for the Jazz to make.

“Most definitely, I think Derrick Favors and Enes are going to be big time big men in this league,”

Al Jefferson on Derrick Favors, Dec 8, 2013. Source: HoopsWorld.

item.title: Billy King on Derrick Favors
item.description:
“I think Derrick Favors is going to be an All-Star down the road. He has unbelievable upside, butI felt we were a little thin at the power forward spot,”

Billy King on Derrick Favors, Aug 12, 2010. Source: New York Post.
